description:
Returns all Productivity Logs for the current date.

See [Working with Daily Logs](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/daily-logs) for information on filtering the response using the log\_date, start\_date, and end\_date parameters. Note that if none of the date parameters are provided in the call, only logs from the current date are returned.

parameters.name: log_date
parameters.description: Date of specific logs desired in YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of specific logs desired in YYYY-MM-DD format (use together with end_date)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of specific logs desired in YYYY-MM-DD format (use together with start_date)

parameters.name: filters[created_by_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) created by the specified User IDs.

rejection_reason.description: Reason given when the log was rejected. Null when no reason was given or the log is not rejected.

rejected_by.description: User who rejected the log. Null when the log is not rejected.

id.description: ID of the user who rejected the log.

name.description: Name of the user who rejected the log.

company.description: The rejecting user's company (vendor) in the project company's directory. Null when the user has no vendor.

rejected_at.description: Timestamp when the log was rejected. Null when the log is not rejected.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Productivity Log.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Productivity Log was created.

line_item_id.description: ID of the Line Item from the approved Commitment Contract

line_item_holder.description: Object that the Line Item belongs to (WorkOrderContract, PurchaseOrderContract, PotentialChangeOrder)

type.description: The type of object that the Line Item belongs to

position.description: Order in which this entry was recorded

previously_delivered.description: Number of materials that were previously delivered on site

previously_used.description: Number of materials previously put in place on site

quantity_delivered.description: Number of materials delivered on site

quantity_used.description: Number of materials put in place on site

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Productivity Log was last updated.
Timestamp of last update to Location

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the segment was soft deleted

deleted.description: Indicates if the segment is deleted

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the Productivity Log was deleted; null if not deleted.

created_by_collaborator.description: Whether this log was created by a collaborator.

403.description: User does not have right permissions
